name: PennApps
venue: University of Pennsylvania, School of Engineering

prizes.name: Best Beginner Hack (>2 members first time)

prize_count_note: 23 non-cash prizes; also Best use of CV, AI, Statistics, Blockchain and AR/VR, and MLH Gemini, MongoDB Atlas and Auth0 prizes. Counts above are winners found on project pages.

criteria.label: Technology
criteria.description: How technically impressive and difficult; clever techniques or many components; a 'wow'.

criteria.label: Design
criteria.description: Thought put into user experience; interface quality or human-computer interaction for hardware.

criteria.label: Completion
criteria.description: Does it work, did the team achieve its goals, how many points of failure were solved.

criteria.label: Learning
criteria.description: Whether the team stretched itself and learned something new, relative to its past projects.

judging.notes: Teams pick up to three tracks plus unlimited categories and MLH prizes on the draft submission (due Saturday 6 pm); the final submission (Sunday 8 am) needs a GitHub repository with a README and a demo video of at most one minute.

submission_requirements: Teams of 2 to 4 students, US only
Draft submission by Saturday 6 pm with idea and intended tracks (max 3) and categories
Final Devpost submission by Sunday 8 am with a GitHub repository and README
Demo video of at most one minute
